definitions.explanation: An open sore that develops on the inner lining of the stomach, causing pain, nausea, and other digestive symptoms. Often associated with stress, irregular eating habits, or bacterial infection.

examples.japanese: {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was diagnosed with a stomach ulcer.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胃潰瘍|いかいよう}になった。
examples.english: I developed a stomach ulcer due to stress.

examples.japanese: {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Treating a stomach ulcer requires taking medication while also being careful about what you eat.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach) and ⟦{潰瘍|かいよう}→潰瘍：29096_kaiyou⟧ (ulcer). A common medical condition in Japan, historically attributed to overwork and stress, making this a word many adult Japanese speakers encounter in daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop a stomach ulcer
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment of a stomach ulcer
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: stomach ulcer medication
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{再発|さいはつ}→再発：09017_saihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: stomach ulcer recurs

RELATED WORDS:
- {十二指腸潰瘍|じゅうにしちょうかいよう}: duodenal ulcer — ulcer in the duodenum, often discussed alongside stomach ulcers
- ⟦{胃炎|いえん}→胃炎：25491_ien⟧: gastritis — inflammation of the stomach lining, less severe
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: gastroscopy — the endoscopic procedure used to diagnose stomach ulcers
- ピロリ⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧: H. pylori — the bacterium that causes many ulcers
